items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: See, well, the three of us were well acquainted with each other.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, you know. Red Nichols was in the band for a while. This was after the war. And Red comes out of a factory. He'd been working in a factory, and during the war he had done that kind of work, you know, for
his draft service or something like that, and he'd gone out of the business for a couple of years.
